info.name: Company Exam Portal API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Company Exam Portal backend.

---

## Quick Start

1. **Import** this file into Postman.
2. Open the collection → **Variables** tab. Set `base_url` if your server is not on port 8000.
3. Run **Admin Login** → token is saved automatically to `admin_token`.
4. Run **Company Register** (attach a PNG/JPEG as the `logo` file field), then **Company Login** → token saved to `company_token`.
5. Admin must approve the company before the company token works on protected routes.
6. For student endpoints, use the `access_token` value from any student record.

## Variable reference

| Variable | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | You | Server root, e.g. `http://localhost:8000` |
| `admin_token` | Admin Login test script | JWT for admin requests |
| `company_token` | Company Login test script | JWT for company requests |
| `student_token` | Student Login test script | Access token for student requests |
| `company_id` | You | ID of a company row |
| `drive_id` | You | ID of a drive row |
| `ticket_id` | You | ID of a ticket row |
| `college_id` | You | ID of a college row |
| `group_id` | You | ID of a student group row |

## Auth rules

- Admin routes: `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_token}}`
- Company routes: `Authorization: Bearer {{company_token}}`
- Student routes: `?token={{student_token}}` query param
- Company register / login / student login: no auth required

request.description: Returns API name, version, environment and links to /docs.
Tests database connectivity. Returns 200 when healthy, 503 when DB is unreachable.
Admin login. On success the test script automatically saves the JWT to the `admin_token` collection variable.

formdata.description: PNG or JPEG, max 2 MB. Click the file icon to select.

request.description: Registers a new company. Send as multipart/form-data — all text fields plus a PNG/JPEG logo file. The company will be in `pending` status until an admin approves it.
Company login. Requires admin approval first. On success the test script saves the JWT to `company_token`.
Sets company status to `approved`. Pass `is_approved: false` to suspend instead.
Sets status to `rejected` and **deletes the company logo from disk**.
Hard-deletes the company. Fails if the company has existing drives.
Returns drive info + all questions + all students + company info + aggregate stats.
Suspends the drive. If exam is ongoing it is ended immediately and all student responses are deleted (students are preserved).
Reactivates a suspended drive (sets status back to `approved`).
Returns exam_state (not_started | ongoing | ended), window times, time remaining, student count and can_start / can_end flags.
Returns custom college names used by companies in drive targets that are not yet in the master list.
Approves a custom college name and updates all DriveTarget references to point to the new master college record.

request.description: Returns full ticket detail including company_name and company_email.

body.raw:
{
    "title": "Backend Engineer Hiring 2026",
    "description": "Assessment for backend engineering candidates. Focus on Python, REST APIs and databases.",
    "category": "Technical MCQ",
    "window_start": "2026-04-10T09:00:00Z",
    "window_end": "2026-04-10T12:00:00Z",
    "exam_duration_minutes": 60,
    "targets": [
        {
            "college_id": null,
            "custom_college_name": "MIT World Peace University",
            "student_group_id": null,
            "custom_student_group_name": "AIDS",
            "batch_year": "2025"
        }
    ],
    "tab_switch_threshold": 3,
    "fullscreen_exit_threshold": 3,
    "right_click_threshold": 3,
    "screenshot_threshold": 1,
    "copy_threshold": null,
    "paste_threshold": null
}

request.description: Creates a drive in `draft` status. `exam_duration_minutes` must be less than the window duration. Use `college_id` / `student_group_id` for master-list entries, or `custom_*` fields for new ones. Violation thresholds are optional (defaults shown); set a threshold to `null` to make that violation type warning-only (never auto-disqualify).
All fields are optional. Only allowed while the drive is not yet approved. Threshold fields can be updated individually; set to `null` to make a violation type warning-only.
Only allowed while the drive is not approved.
Changes status from `draft` → `submitted`. Requires at least one question and one student.
Copies the drive (and all questions and targets) into a new `draft` drive with a `(Copy)` suffix. Window times are reset to null.
Opens the exam window. Sets `actual_window_start` to now and calculates `actual_window_end` from the configured window duration. Students can log in and begin their individual exam timer.
Manually closes the window early. All students whose exam is still in progress are auto-submitted.

formdata.description: CSV file. Required columns: question, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_answer (full option text), points (optional, default 1). See docs/sample_datascience_questions.csv for a sample.

request.description: `correct_answer` must be the exact text of one of the four options. Not allowed on approved drives.

formdata.description: CSV file. Required columns: question_text, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_answer (A/B/C/D letter), points (optional), difficulty (optional: easy/medium/hard).

request.description: Alternative upload endpoint. `correct_answer` here must be the letter A, B, C, or D.

formdata.description: CSV file. Required columns: name, email, roll_number. Optional: phone, college, student_group. See docs/sample_students_with_rollnumber.csv for a sample.

request.description: Duplicate emails within the same drive are silently skipped. Not allowed on approved drives.

request.description: Downloads a CSV with Name, Email, Roll Number, College, Student Group, Score, Total, Percentage, Status, Is_Disqualified.
Same as summary but adds Q1, Q2, … columns showing each student's per-question answer and correctness.
Returns the current subject/body template and the list of available `{{variable}}` placeholders.
Validates that all `{{variable}}` placeholders are from the allowed list before saving.
Renders the template with sample data and returns rendered_subject, rendered_body and sample_data_used.
Checks whether the drive is approved, has students, and SMTP is configured. Returns can_send_emails and a status message.
Sends the email template (rendered per-student) to all students in the drive via SMTP. Returns sent_count, failed_count and details of any failed emails. Drive must be approved.

category: billing | drive | technical | general
priority: low | medium | high | urgent
Status is always `open` on creation.
Returns all tickets raised by the authenticated company, newest first.
Student logs in with email + access_token (UUID from the students table). Returns drive info and current drive_status.
Confirms token is valid and returns is_disqualified status.
Returns drive title, description, exam_duration_minutes, window times and calculated status.
Generates a randomised question_order for this student and records exam_started_at. Must be called within the active exam window.
Returns questions in the student's randomised order. correct_answer is NOT included. Also returns expected_end (student start time + exam_duration_minutes).

Records a violation and automatically disqualifies the student if the per-drive threshold for that type is reached. violation_type must be one of: tab_switch | fullscreen_exit | right_click | screenshot | copy | paste. Response includes is_disqualified (bool) — when true the student has been locked out and the frontend should redirect to a disqualification screen. copy and paste have a null threshold by default (warning-only, never auto-disqualify).
Submits all answers. selected_option can be A/B/C/D or null (unanswered). Returns score, total_marks and percentage.
Returns score, total_marks, percentage, submitted_at, is_disqualified and violation_details.
Replace the filename segment with the value from `logo_url` returned in the company list or login response (e.g. `/static/logos/reg_acmecorp_abc123.png`).

item.name: Admin acting as Company (X-Company-ID header)
item.description: Several company-scoped endpoints also accept an admin JWT + X-Company-ID header. This lets an admin browse any company's data without needing the company's credentials.
